newsitem.title: JAPAN: Joyo Bank to write off 32 bln yen in bad loans.
newsitem.headline: Joyo Bank to write off 32 bln yen in bad loans.

text.p: Joyo Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that it would write off bad loans worth 32 billion yen in the financial year ended in March 1997.
The Japanese bank said in a statement that it would post an appraisal loss of 10.78 billion yen on securities holdings at the end of the financial year.
The bank also said that it would post an operating profit of 43.8 billion yen in 1996/97.
Earlier, the bank sharply lowered its earnings estimates for 1996/97 due to the sluggish Tokyo stock market and the planned loan write-offs.
